lines.text: What if ten years from now, you wake up and completely hate your life?
A wolf in a pinstripe suit slides a golden pen across the desk: 'Sign here, kid.'
'An easy road. No struggle. Just skip the hard years.'
The young pup hesitates, clutching his ears: 'Is there really no catch?'
'None at all,' the wolf whispers with a sly grin. 'Just sign your twenties away.'
With a trembling paw, he signs... and the room fades to black.
Three in the morning. Lying awake in the dead blue glare of a phone.
In the dusty mirror, he clutches an old photo of who he used to be.
Suddenly, you snap back to that warm room. The contract lies unsigned.
Ten years were just handed back to you. So what will you choose today?
